message.content:
A magazine cover with a red background features a large illustration and various text elements. Centered at the top, "TEMPO" is printed in large, black, serif block letters. Above it, white text reads "MANUVER MURAHAN PRESIDEN TIGA PERIODE" and "PRO DAN KONTRA REFORMASI PAJAK," separated by a diagonal line. Below "TEMPO," "50 Tahun!" is written in a black cursive script. The main headline, "SIASAT GELAP FIRLI," appears in large, white, bold sans-serif letters.

Below the headline is a paragraph of white text: "Ketua Komisi Pemberantasan Korupsi Firli Bahuri disebut menyandera koleganya di KPK dengan berbagai cara tercela. Tim IndonesiaLeaks kini menguak sejumlah dugaan gratifikasinya."

The illustration depicts a large man in a tan, short-sleeved uniform with three stars on his epaulettes. He holds several white ropes, acting as leashes, which are tied to the bound hands of four smaller figures in dark suits. These figures, including one woman in a hijab, are positioned as if pulling forward against the tension of the ropes. Their faces show strained or grimacing expressions. 

The bottom left corner contains publishing details: "21-27 JUNI 2021," price "RP 45.000," and "WWW.TEMPO.CO." A barcode and QR code are also present.
